rows.Kwic: 往鐘陵開元寺道玄律師受具足戒。

Override.AttributionNote: Extensive Record of Chan Master Xuansha Shibei (玄沙師備禪師廣錄), opening biographical notice explicitly introduced as according to Master Zongyi (按宗一大師). Zongyi is the exact named narrative source who says Xuansha Shibei went to Vinaya Master Daoxuan at Kaiyuan monastery and received the full precepts. Xuansha is the biographical subject, not the narrator; Yitong and Hongzhao are earlier named teachers, Daoxuan the ordination preceptor, and Xuefeng Yicun the later quoted appraiser.
